nodes.description: uint256 private _guardCounter; reentrancy mutex counter in ReentrancyGuard.
IERC20 public rewardsToken; ERC20 token paid out as rewards (Lever token).
uint256 public periodFinish; timestamp when the reward period ends.
uint256 public rewardRate; reward tokens distributed per second.
uint256 public rewardsDuration; length of the reward period (default 30 days).
uint256 public lastUpdateTime; last time rewards were updated.
uint256 public rewardPerTokenStored; last checkpointed reward per token value.
mapping(address => uint256) userRewardPerTokenPaid; per-user reward checkpoint.
mapping(address => uint256) rewards; accrued unclaimed rewards per user.
IMarginPoolAddressesProvider public addressesProvider; registry used for rewards distribution and token lookups.
POOL address inherited from DebtTokenBase; the margin pool that owns this debt token.
UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS inherited from DebtTokenBase; asset whose debt is tracked.
library Math.min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; returns the smaller value.
library Math.max(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; returns the larger value.
library Math.average(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; returns the rounded-down average.
VariableDebtToken constructor; initializes DebtTokenBase, addressesProvider and rewardsToken.
balanceOf(address user) view; scaled balance multiplied by the reserve normalized variable debt index.
mint(address user, address onBehalfOf, uint256 amount, uint256 index) external onlyMarginPool updateReward; mints scaled debt.
burn(address user, uint256 amount, uint256 index) external onlyMarginPool updateReward; burns scaled debt.
scaledBalanceOf(address user) view; raw scaled principal balance.
totalSupply() view; scaled total supply multiplied by the variable debt index.
scaledTotalSupply() view; returns super.totalSupply().
getScaledUserBalanceAndSupply(address user) view; returns user scaled balance and total scaled supply.
_transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal override updateReward(from) updateReward(to); hooks reward update into transfers.
lastTimeRewardApplicable() view; Math.min(block.timestamp, periodFinish).
rewardPerToken() view; cumulative reward per token derived from rate, elapsed time and totalSupply.
earned(address account) view; reward owed to an account.
getRewardForDuration() view; rewardRate multiplied by rewardsDuration.
getReward() public nonReentrant updateReward(msg.sender); zeroes rewards and transfers them out.
notifyRewardAmount(uint256 reward, uint256 _rewardsDuration) external onlyRewardsDistribution updateReward(address(0)); sets reward schedule.
modifier updateReward(address account); checkpoints rewardPerTokenStored, lastUpdateTime and per-account rewards.
modifier nonReentrant(); mutex guard using _guardCounter.
modifier onlyRewardsDistribution(); requires msg.sender == addressesProvider.getRewardsDistribution().

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the account whose rewards are read, zeroed and paid in getReward.
msg.sender is compared against addressesProvider.getRewardsDistribution() in the onlyRewardsDistribution guard.
block.timestamp governs lastTimeRewardApplicable via Math.min(block.timestamp, periodFinish).
block.timestamp selects the reward-schedule branch and lastUpdateTime in notifyRewardAmount.
updateReward(onBehalfOf) modifier executes before mint body.
updateReward(user) modifier executes before burn body.
updateReward(from) and updateReward(to) wrap the _transfer override.
updateReward(msg.sender) modifier executes before getReward body.
nonReentrant mutex guards getReward, the only function performing an outbound token transfer.
onlyRewardsDistribution restricts notifyRewardAmount to the rewards distribution contract.
rewardsToken.safeTransfer to msg.sender is an external callback; rewards[msg.sender] is zeroed before the call and nonReentrant is applied, mitigating reentrancy.
getReward invokes rewardsToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, reward).
notifyRewardAmount reads rewardsToken.balanceOf(address(this)) to bound rewardRate.
balanceOf queries POOL.getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt for the current debt index.
totalSupply queries POOL.getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt for the current debt index.
updateReward writes rewardPerTokenStored = rewardPerToken().
updateReward writes lastUpdateTime = lastTimeRewardApplicable().
updateReward writes rewards[account] = earned(account).
updateReward writes userRewardPerTokenPaid[account] = rewardPerTokenStored.
notifyRewardAmount assigns rewardsDuration = _rewardsDuration.
notifyRewardAmount recomputes rewardRate from reward, leftover and duration.
notifyRewardAmount sets periodFinish = block.timestamp + rewardsDuration.
notifyRewardAmount sets lastUpdateTime = block.timestamp.
notifyRewardAmount reads rewardsToken to check contract balance.
constructor assigns addressesProvider = IMarginPoolAddressesProvider(_addressesProvider).
constructor assigns rewardsToken from addressesProvider.getLeverToken().
getReward reads and zeroes rewards[msg.sender].
getRewardForDuration multiplies rewardRate by rewardsDuration.
getRewardForDuration reads rewardsDuration.
earned calls balanceOf(account).
earned calls rewardPerToken().
earned subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid[account].
earned adds rewards[account].
rewardPerToken calls lastTimeRewardApplicable().
rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply().
rewardPerToken reads rewardPerTokenStored as the base value.
rewardPerToken subtracts lastUpdateTime.
rewardPerToken multiplies elapsed time by rewardRate.
lastTimeRewardApplicable calls Math.min(block.timestamp, periodFinish).
lastTimeRewardApplicable reads periodFinish.
balanceOf calls POOL.getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt.
balanceOf passes UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS to the reserve lookup.
totalSupply calls POOL.getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt.
totalSupply passes UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS to the reserve lookup.

localCounter snapshots _guardCounter inside the nonReentrant mutex logic.
local scaledBalance holds super.balanceOf(user) in balanceOf.
local amountScaled holds amount.rayDiv(index) in mint.
local previousBalance records the pre-mint scaled balance in mint.
local amountScaled holds amount.rayDiv(index) in burn.
local balance holds rewardsToken.balanceOf(address(this)) in notifyRewardAmount.
local remaining holds periodFinish - block.timestamp in notifyRewardAmount.
local leftover holds remaining * rewardRate in notifyRewardAmount.
local reward holds rewards[msg.sender] before it is zeroed and transferred.
